Name: Ali's Enchanted Garden Buildings - Alternative Textures Version by glymr
Author: glymr
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod is compatible with 1.6! Please let me k now if you encounter any errors.[/size][/b]

This is a conversion of "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/641]Ali's Enchanted Garden Buildings[/url]" to work with Alternative Textures. The original creator of the assets, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]strawberrymilk95[/url], gave explicit permission for conversion in the original mod's description here (relevant part bolded):

"[b]12/08/19 UPDATE:[/b]
Unfortunately I will not be supporting this mod anymore meaning there will be no future updates. [...] [b]If you wish to update it or modify it yourself you are welcome to do so, posting it is fine as long as credit is given :-)[/b]"

All credit for creation of the original assets goes to strawberrmilk95. Thank you so much for giving permission to update your mod! <3

Note that there is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4544]another conversion of this pack for Content Patcher[/url] by naeldeus. The CP version adds a second version of the shed. I have not included this new version of the shed because I don't have permission from naeldeus. If they give me permission in the future, I will add it to this pack. Currently, only the original shed version from the original mod is included.

As you upgrade your house, you will have the option to choose the previous versions of the house instead. There are also two versions of the silo and the junimo hut. One has lighter wood accents and the other has darker wood accents.

This pack is NOT seasonal (except for the junimo hut).
